scripts.test:rules: if lsof -ti tcp:9000 >/dev/null; then FIREBASE_DATABASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9000 tsx scripts/test-rules.mts; else firebase emulators:exec --only database "tsx scripts/test-rules.mts"; fi
scripts.test:room: if lsof -ti tcp:9000 >/dev/null; then tsx scripts/test-room.ts; else firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,database "tsx scripts/test-room.ts"; fi
scripts.test:dm: if lsof -ti tcp:9000 >/dev/null; then tsx scripts/test-dm.ts; else firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,database "tsx scripts/test-dm.ts"; fi
scripts.test:account: if lsof -ti tcp:9000 >/dev/null; then tsx scripts/test-account.ts; else firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,database "tsx scripts/test-account.ts"; fi
scripts.test:library: if lsof -ti tcp:8080 >/dev/null; then echo 'npm run dev 에뮬레이터를 먼저 꺼 주세요 (Storage 규칙의 Firestore 교차 조회는 테스트 전용 프로젝트에서만 검증 — 로컬 데이터를 지우지 않도록)'; exit 1; fi; firebase emulators:exec --project demo-adelie-library --only firestore,storage "npx tsx scripts/test-library.mts"
